subject: Renewal + Uplift: MSA & Order Form legal alignment
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Talia Nguyen <talia@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal: 18mo term + 35% capacity uplift — legal paperwork attached

Talia — thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, BrightBridge is looking to: (1) extend the subscription for 18 months, (2) increase committed capacity by ~35% across the inference seat tiers, and (3) apply the agreed 12% volume discount to the new committed baseline.

I’m attaching a clean OrderForm_v3.pdf and the MSA_Amendment_2026.docx with the items we discussed. High level asks for your team: please provide redlines on the MSA changes (data retention, indemnity language, SLA credits) and confirm the PO path and expected signature party for DocuSign.

Tentative timeline: we want legal alignment by 12/15 so the new term can start 1/1/2027 (billing to follow). If there are sticking points, highlight them and we’ll loop in Legal / Procurement.

Next steps: 
- Talia: return redlines to the MSA by EOD 12/03 if possible
- Ben: will prepare a short summary of price/capacity changes for procurement
- Laura: can you produce a one-page redline digest for counterparty review?

Thanks — Mark

--
Markus Klein
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147
From: Talia Nguyen <talia@brightbridge.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: 18mo term + 35% capacity uplift — legal paperwork attached

Markus — thanks, received. Internal procurement and Legal reviewed the deck and MSA amendment. We attached MSA_Amendment_2026-markup.pdf with comments in sections 2, 5 and 9 (data retention, audit rights, and SLA credits respectively). A couple of clarifying items up front: 

- Data retention: we need a 90-day default retention for inference results unless otherwise agreed for specific workloads.
- SLA credits: procurement requests a floor of 25% of monthly invoice as the maximum cumulative credit; Legal is asking for clearer measurement windows.
- Indemnity carveouts: we have a minor ask around third-party IP claims for generated outputs.

Procurement will also require a PO number before signature; I’ve looped them on this thread (procurement@brightbridge.ai). We can turn around comments by 12/04 EOD. If any of these items are deal-breakers, flag them and we’ll prioritize.

Regards,
Talia Nguyen
Head of Platform & Integrations | BrightBridge AI
Talia Nguyen <talia@brightbridge.ai>
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal: quick internal legal posture and asks

Markus / Ben — quick internal note after reading BrightBridge's marked MSA: 

On the points raised by Talia, my recommendations are: 
1) Data retention: accept a 90-day default for inference outputs but add an exception for archived logs required for security investigations (up to 12 months, access-controlled). This preserves our caching performance guarantees while meeting customer privacy asks.
2) SLA credits: propose a compromise cap at 20% of monthly invoice (compared to their requested 25%) plus a defined measurement window (monthly with a 30-day rectification period).
3) IP indemnity: propose indemnity language limited to willful infringement; push back on broad generated-output indemnity and request narrow carveouts.

I can draft a concise redline summary and a short exec note to send to BrightBridge. Ben — can you confirm the pricing spreadsheet numbers and provide the revised OrderForm (with the 35% uplift) for the summary?

If all good, we’ll send a single consolidated redline + digest to Talia and procurement. Target: send by 12/07 so we can close by 12/15.

--
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Talia Nguyen <talia@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 10:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: 18mo term + 35% capacity uplift — proposed next steps and summary

Talia — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per Laura’s recommendations, we’re proposing the following compromise package (attached summary): 

- Term: 18 months (start 2027-01-01)
- Capacity: 35% committed uplift applied to the baseline seat tiers on OrderForm_v3 (Ben attached updated pricing to the Deal record)
- Data retention: default 90 days; exceptions for security logs up to 12 months (access-controlled) — see clause redline
- SLA credits: cap at 20% monthly invoice with a 30-day rectification cure; operational metrics defined in Exhibit F
- IP: narrow indemnity for willful infringement; no broad generated-output indemnity

Attachments: Redline_Summary_20261207.txt (one-page digest), OrderForm_v3.pdf (updated pricing), MSA_Amendment_2026.docx (clean with accepted changes noted).

DocuSign prep: I created an envelope and placeholder signature fields at https://www.docusign.com/sign/ZZY-998877 — procurement can use that link once PO is provided.

Request: please confirm these points by 12/15. If BrightBridge agrees, we will ask our Legal Ops to bake the final redline and route for signature the same day.

Thanks — Mark
